comments.note: [documentation-forward] ILibraryFolderRepository.AddAsync (src/VideoIndexer.Core/Abstractions/ILibraryFolderRepository.cs) has a stale <remarks> block that reads 'until a null guard is added to the concrete implementation a null path may propagate a NullReferenceException'. WP-006 has added ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(path) to the concrete implementation, making this language incorrect. Update the remarks to remove the stale caveat and add a proper <exception cref="ArgumentException">Thrown when path is null, empty, or whitespace-only.</exception> XML doc tag to the method signature.

AddAsync accepts paths with leading/trailing whitespace (e.g., '  /valid/path  ') — the guard correctly rejects whitespace-only strings but does not trim. This is a design choice and not a defect, but it may lead to duplicate-folder bugs if callers do not normalise paths before calling AddAsync. Worth considering a path.Trim() or enforcing normalisation at a higher layer in a future WP.
